articles.title_en: Wealth tax enforcement in Sweden: Filing requirements and pre-populated returns
articles.title_cn: 瑞典财富税执行：申报要求与预填申报表
articles.abstract_en: This paper shows that two features of wealth tax administration in Sweden – (1) filing requirements and (2) pre-populated returns–have a large impact on compliance even in an environment with highly-developed third-party reporting through information returns. Up to 1993, all taxpayers had to fill in wealth information when filing the (joint) income and wealth tax return. In 1994–1996, only those with net wealth above the exemption threshold (approximately the top 10 %) needed to fill in wealth information. This leads to a very large reduction of about half of the number of taxpayers slightly above the wealth tax exemption threshold, and a reduction of about 20 % in the total number of wealth taxpayers above the threshold. Starting in 1997, Sweden began pre-populating wealth information on tax returns for taxpayers with third-party-reported net wealth above the exemption threshold. Symmetrically, this immediately doubles the number of taxpayers slightly above the threshold and increases the number of all wealth taxpayers by almost 20 %. The introduction of information returns for financial wealth in 1986 had a comparatively small impact on wealth reporting.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文表明，瑞典财富税管理中的两个特征——（1）申报要求和（2）预填申报表——即使在通过信息申报表进行高度发达的第三方报告的环境中，也对合规性产生了重大影响。截至1993年，所有纳税人在提交（联合）所得税和财富税申报表时都必须填写财富信息。在1994-1996年，只有净财富超过免税门槛（大约前10%）的纳税人才需要填写财富信息。这导致略高于财富税免税门槛的纳税人数量大幅减少约一半，并且高于门槛的财富税纳税人总数减少了约20%。从1997年开始，瑞典开始为第三方报告净财富超过免税门槛的纳税人在税表上预填财富信息。对称地，这立即使得略高于门槛的纳税人数量翻倍，并使所有财富税纳税人数量增加了近20%。1986年引入金融财富信息申报表对财富报告的影响相对较小。

articles.title_en: Does SNAP participation increase bulk purchases?
articles.title_cn: 参与SNAP是否增加了批量购买？
articles.abstract_en: The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) issues monthly lump-sum payments. One potential benefit of SNAP payments is that they could ease liquidity constraints for participating households. Using novel retailer panel data, this is the first study to investigate the effect of SNAP on bulk purchasing behavior using within-household variation. To estimate a causal relationship between SNAP and bulk purchases, we use the timing of program re-certification as a source of exogenous variation in the decision to participate in SNAP. We find that participating in SNAP increases the expenditure share of bulk purchases for all groceries by six percentage points. Analyses aiming to disentangle whether increased bulk spending among SNAP households reflects an “income effect” or a “liquidity effect” point to the former, with spending patterns indicating “splurge behavior” rather than efforts to minimize prices.
articles.abstract_cn: 补充营养援助计划（SNAP）每月发放一次性付款。SNAP付款的一个潜在好处是它们可以缓解参与家庭的流动性约束。利用新颖的零售商面板数据，这是第一项使用家庭内变异研究SNAP对批量购买行为影响的研究。为了估计SNAP与批量购买之间的因果关系，我们使用项目重新认证的时间作为参与SNAP决策的外生变异来源。我们发现，参与SNAP使所有杂货的批量购买支出份额增加了六个百分点。旨在厘清SNAP家庭批量支出增加反映的是“收入效应”还是“流动性效应”的分析指向前者，支出模式表明“挥霍行为”而非努力最小化价格。

articles.title_en: Climate and migration in the United States
articles.abstract_en: We study whether households engage in climate-related migration in the United States, a country where most of the population does not regularly experience natural disasters or work in climate-exposed industries. With comprehensive, long-run data from both the Census and tax filings, we document that warm temperatures induce net out-migration, while cooler temperatures do not. By comparing estimates from models using different lengths of temporal variation, we further show that migration is a medium-run response to high temperatures: decadal and longer shifts in weather have larger annualized impacts than year-over-year changes. Finally, comparisons across county types suggest amenity value is an important mechanism behind climate-related migration in the United States.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究美国家庭是否进行与气候相关的移民，美国大多数人口并不经常经历自然灾害或从事气候暴露行业。利用人口普查和税务申报的全面长期数据，我们记录了温暖气温导致净迁出，而较冷气温则不然。通过比较使用不同时间变化长度的模型估计，我们进一步表明移民是对高温的中期反应：十年及更长时间的气候变化比年度变化具有更大的年化影响。最后，跨县类型的比较表明，舒适度价值是美国气候相关移民背后的重要机制。

articles.title_en: VAT incidence in real VAT systems
articles.title_cn: 实际增值税制度中的增值税归宿
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the price impacts of Value Added Tax (VAT) in the presence of size-based exemptions, which are set relatively high in the firm-size distribution in developing contexts. In addition to the standard determinants of tax incidence, we show that pass-through of VAT to consumer prices will depend on the substitutability of registered and unregistered varieties of taxed goods, on pass-through at upstream stages, and on the extent of segregation between registered and unregistered supply chains. The exemption can also distort the quality of goods produced. We show that these mechanisms are empirically important in the context of a VAT in India, where those who consume at unregistered firms nevertheless bear some of the tax burden.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在存在基于规模的免税政策时增值税对价格的影响，这些免税政策在发展中国家企业规模分布中设定得相对较高。除了税收归宿的标准决定因素外，我们表明增值税向消费者价格的传导将取决于应税商品注册与非注册品种的可替代性、上游阶段的传导程度，以及注册与非注册供应链之间的隔离程度。免税还可能扭曲所生产商品的质量。我们证明这些机制在印度增值税背景下具有实证重要性，在那里，尽管消费者在非注册企业消费，但仍承担部分税收负担。

articles.title_en: Frictions in recovering unclaimed property: Evidence from a large-scale natural field experiment
articles.title_cn: 收回无人认领财产中的摩擦：来自大规模自然现场实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Governments hold billions of dollars in assets abandoned or forgotten by their owners. We conducted a large-scale natural field experiment to understand the role of filing frictions preventing claims of this property. Overall, increasing awareness and providing instructions increased claims substantially. We also study unequal access. In the control group, Hispanic property owners are 64 % less likely to claim their property than White owners, leading to unequal access to one’s own property. Hispanic subjects are also less responsive to aid. We discuss policy implications and how the setting we introduce can be used to conduct natural field experiments without the biases and restrictions that may arise when conducting experiments with a partner organization.
articles.abstract_cn: 政府持有数十亿美元被所有者遗弃或遗忘的资产。我们进行了一项大规模自然现场实验，以了解申请这些财产时存在的申请摩擦所起的作用。总体而言，提高意识和提供说明显著增加了申请量。我们还研究了获取机会的不平等。在对照组中，西班牙裔财产所有者认领其财产的可能性比白人所有者低64%，导致人们对自己财产的获取机会不平等。西班牙裔受试者对援助的响应度也较低。我们讨论了政策含义，以及我们引入的设置如何用于开展自然现场实验，而不会产生与合作伙伴组织进行实验时可能出现的偏见和限制。

articles.title_en: Discrimination and assimilation: Evidence from anti-Chinese sentiments in the United States
articles.title_cn: 歧视与同化：来自美国反华情绪的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the interactions between members of a discriminated minority, members of the majority group, and political leaders. We construct a novel dataset of all tweets posted by “White American” and Chinese users located in the United States from January to August 2020. Using a variety of supervised and unsupervised text-analysis techniques, we show that anti-Chinese discrimination on Twitter significantly increased following (i) the COVID-19 outbreak, and (ii) Donald Trump’s tweet referring to COVID-19 as the “Chinese virus." We then study the reaction of the Chinese minority and find that, after Trump’s tweet, Chinese users were significantly more likely to (i) tweet assimilation-related content, and (ii) tweet criticism against the Chinese Communist Party. The rise in assimilation-related content is generally stronger for users who were more integrated before the shock.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了受歧视少数群体成员、多数群体成员与政治领袖之间的互动。我们构建了一个新的数据集，包含2020年一月至八月期间位于美国的“白人美国人”和中国用户发布的所有推文。利用多种有监督和无监督的文本分析技术，我们表明，在（i）COVID-19爆发以及（ii）唐纳德·特朗普将COVID-19称为“中国病毒”的推文之后，Twitter上的反华歧视显著增加。随后，我们研究了中国少数群体的反应，发现特朗普推文后，中国用户更可能（i）发布与同化相关的内容，以及（ii）发布批评中国共产党的推文。同化相关内容的增加通常对于在冲击前更为融入的用户更为显著。

articles.title_en: Old money: Campaign finance and gerontocracy in the United States
articles.title_cn: 老钱：美国的竞选资金与老人政治
articles.abstract_en: Politicians in the United States rank among the oldest globally. This study examines how money in politics contributes to age inequality in political representation. Using record-linkage to construct a novel data set combining the ages of voters, donors, and candidates, we find that the median dollar in US elections comes from a 66-year-old — significantly older than the median voter, candidate, or elected official. Results from within-district and within-donor analyses confirm that age proximity with candidates increases contributions on the extensive and intensive margins. Finally, we simulate candidate fundraising by age under a hypothetical campaign finance voucher policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国的政治家在全球范围内属于最年长之列。本研究探讨了金钱在政治中如何导致政治代表中的年龄不平等。通过使用记录链接构建一个结合选民、捐赠者和候选人年龄的新数据集，我们发现美国选举中的中位数美元来自一位66岁的人——显著年长于中位数选民、候选人或当选官员。区内和捐赠者内分析的结果证实，与候选人的年龄接近会增加捐赠的广度和强度边际。最后，我们在假设的竞选财政券政策下模拟了按年龄划分的候选人筹款情况。

articles.title_cn: 风险规避非营利组织的拍卖
articles.abstract_en: Fundraising for non-profit organizations (NPOs) often involves converting in-kind donations into cash, commonly through charity auctions. However, little attention has been paid to the revenue distributions these mechanisms generate, an obvious concern for risk-averse NPOs deciding on a fundraising strategy. This paper introduces a theoretical framework that evaluates the first two moments of the revenue distributions accruing to ten auction formats under conditions that permit endogenous bidder participation. The resulting “revenue frontier” generated by these mechanisms reveals a robust and sizeable mean-variance tradeoff that NPOs should consider when selecting which mechanism(s) to employ. We test the model’s predictions for each auction format using both laboratory and field experiments and find evidence of a substantial (and similar) tradeoff in each setting. Additionally, we show how bidder participation can modulate an NPO’s risk exposure, conditional on the auction formats selected. These results offer important insights into how NPOs might optimize their fundraising strategies through methods of mechanism diversification.
articles.abstract_cn: 非营利组织（NPOs）的筹款活动通常涉及将实物捐赠转化为现金，常见方式是通过慈善拍卖。然而，对于这些机制所产生的收入分配，关注甚少，而这对于决定筹款策略的风险规避型非营利组织而言，是一个显而易见的关切点。本文引入了一个理论框架，在允许内生投标者参与的条件下，评估了十种拍卖形式所产生的收入分配的前两个矩。这些机制所产生的“收入前沿”揭示了一个稳健且显著的均值-方差权衡，非营利组织在选择采用哪种或哪些机制时应予以考虑。我们通过实验室和实地实验检验了每种拍卖形式的模型预测，并发现每种情境下都存在实质性（且相似）的权衡。此外，我们还展示了投标者参与如何根据所选拍卖形式调节非营利组织的风险敞口。这些结果为非营利组织如何通过机制多样化来优化其筹款策略提供了重要见解。

articles.title_en: Does black and blue matter? An experimental investigation of race, perceptions of police, and legal compliance
articles.title_cn: 黑与蓝重要吗？一项关于种族、警察认知与守法行为的实验研究
articles.abstract_en: Using an online experiment, we examine the role of race in perceptions of policing and willingness to violate the law. Black and White subjects were asked to imagine themselves driving in a real (but unnamed) majority White or majority non-White US city in which the police department was either majority White or majority non-White. Subjects were incentivized to drive quickly but also warned that they might receive a ticket based on their speed, their personal characteristics, and the real-life ticketing practices in that city. Expectations about the likelihood of being ticketed for speeding were higher among Black subjects than among White subjects. Black subjects also showed a higher willingness to pay for information on the racial makeup of the police department. However, Black subjects drove at similar speeds under all conditions tested, regardless of the racial demographics of the city, the racial composition of the police department, or the disparity or congruence of the two. By contrast, White subjects drove faster when police departments were not racially representative.
articles.abstract_cn: 通过一项在线实验，我们考察了种族在警务感知和违法意愿中的作用。黑人和白人受试者被要求想象自己在一个真实的（但未具名的）美国城市中驾驶，该城市要么以白人为主，要么以非白人为主，且其警察部门要么以白人为主，要么以非白人为主。受试者被激励快速驾驶，但也被告知他们可能因速度、个人特征以及该城市实际的开罚单做法而收到罚单。黑人受试者对超速被开罚单可能性的预期高于白人受试者。黑人受试者还表现出更高的意愿支付费用以获取警察部门种族构成的信息。然而，在所有测试条件下，无论城市的种族人口统计、警察部门的种族构成，还是两者的差异或一致性如何，黑人受试者的驾驶速度都相似。相比之下，当警察部门不具有种族代表性时，白人受试者驾驶速度更快。

articles.title_en: Prices vs quantities with risk aversion
articles.title_cn: 风险规避下的价格与数量规制
articles.abstract_en: Weitzman (1974) asks whether we should regulate a good by fixing quantity or by fixing price when cost and benefit are uncertain. His welfare criterion—expected aggregate surplus—tacitly imposes two strong quasilinearity assumptions on a consumer’s preferences: neutrality with respect to income risk; and absence of income effects on the valuation of the good. Both are matters of first-order importance for the evaluation of allocations under uncertainty. Here I ask how risk aversion affects the choice between the two when the regulated good is a public good. I give conditions for welfare—in the form of the sum of certainty equivalents—to be higher for a fixed price; the conditions allow arbitrarily-high levels of risk aversion, even though consumers bear no uncertainty about quantity or income with a fixed quantity. The conclusion depends crucially on benefit uncertainty, present but irrelevant in Weitzman. An unintended consequence is a surprising new argument against quantity regulation: risk aversion.
articles.abstract_cn: 韦茨曼（1974）提出，在成本与收益不确定时，我们应通过固定数量还是固定价格来规制一种商品。他的福利标准——期望总剩余——隐含地对消费者偏好施加了两个强拟线性假设：对收入风险的中性；以及收入对商品估值无影响。这两者在不确定性下的配置评估中具有首要重要性。在此，我探讨当被规制商品为公共品时，风险规避如何影响两者之间的选择。我给出了福利——以确定性等值之和的形式——在固定价格下更高的条件；这些条件允许任意高的风险规避水平，尽管在固定数量下消费者不承担关于数量或收入的不确定性。结论关键取决于收益不确定性，这在韦茨曼中存在但无关紧要。一个意外的后果是反对数量规制的新论据：风险规避。

articles.title_en: The effects of extortion and security device adoption on entrepreneurial entry and exit: Evidence from Guatemala
articles.title_cn: 勒索与安全设备采用对创业进入和退出的影响：来自危地马拉的证据
articles.abstract_en: Using survey data and administrative records from franchise stores of a multinational company operating in Guatemala’s food retail sector, we document stylized empirical facts about extortion of low-income microentrepreneurs and the protective impact of security cameras. Extortion curtails market entry, increases exit, and lowers economic competition. Security cameras reduce exit and improve competition. To rationalize these findings, we propose a standard model of industry dynamics in which we incorporate extortion as a sales tax and security devices as a costly investment that lowers the probability of victimization. We structurally estimate the model to conduct counterfactual policy simulations and compare the effectiveness of security cameras with that of alternative security devices.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用在危地马拉食品零售行业运营的一家跨国公司的特许经营店的调查数据和行政记录，我们记录了关于低收入微型企业家遭受勒索以及安全摄像头的保护性影响的风格化实证事实。勒索抑制了市场进入，增加了退出，并降低了经济竞争。安全摄像头减少了退出并改善了竞争。为了合理化这些发现，我们提出了一个标准的行业动态模型，在其中我们将勒索视为销售税，将安全设备视为一种降低受害概率的昂贵投资。我们对模型进行结构估计，以进行反事实政策模拟，并比较安全摄像头与替代安全设备的有效性。

articles.title_en: The value of private business in the United States
articles.abstract_en: Private companies account for almost half of aggregate sales and profits of the US economy, but valuing them is difficult due to lack of public market data. This paper uses two databases of private business transactions to estimate valuation ratios and applies them to private business aggregates. We estimate aggregate private business wealth of $14.1 trillion in 2018, twice as large as measured in the Financial Accounts. Our estimates of partnership wealth are six times larger than Financial Accounts estimates, which value partnerships at book value with no adjustment from market based multiples.
articles.abstract_cn: 私营企业占美国经济总销售额和利润的近一半，但由于缺乏公开市场数据，对其进行估值较为困难。本文利用两个私营企业交易数据库来估算估值比率，并将其应用于私营企业总量。我们估计2018年私营企业总财富为14.1万亿美元，是金融账户中测量值的两倍。我们对合伙企业财富的估计比金融账户估计值大六倍，后者以账面价值对合伙企业进行估值，且未根据市场倍数进行调整。

articles.title_en: The undoing of economic sanctions: Evidence from the Russia–Ukraine conflict
articles.title_cn: 经济制裁的失效：来自俄乌冲突的证据
articles.abstract_en: We examine the effects of Ukraine’s economic blockade of the anthracite-rich Donbas region, to demonstrate how trade sanctions’ efficacy can be undermined by trade through non-participatory nations. We document that after the blockade was imposed in March 2017, Russia reported a sharp increase in anthracite imports from Ukraine, while Ukraine reported no exports to Russia at all. We interpret this gap in “mirror statistics” as reflecting a shift in Donbas trade through Russia. Concurrently, Ukraine’s anthracite imports from Russia increased sharply (from near-zero), indicating that some of the increased supply of anthracite in Russia was exported back to Ukraine. We provide suggestive evidence that Russian traders benefited from monopsony rents, buying low-priced anthracite from Donbas while Russia sold anthracite to Ukraine at prices comparable to other export markets. Overall, our findings highlight some of the economic and geographic features that may raise the cost and limit the efficacy of sanctions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了乌克兰对富含无烟煤的顿巴斯地区实施经济封锁的影响，以展示贸易制裁的有效性如何被非参与国的贸易所削弱。我们记录到，在2017年三月实施封锁后，俄罗斯报告从乌克兰进口的无烟煤急剧增加，而乌克兰则报告对俄罗斯的出口为零。我们将这种“镜像统计”中的差异解释为顿巴斯贸易通过俄罗斯转移的反映。与此同时，乌克兰从俄罗斯进口的无烟煤急剧增加（从接近零开始），表明俄罗斯增加的无烟煤供应中有一部分被出口回乌克兰。我们提供了暗示性证据，表明俄罗斯贸易商从买方垄断租金中获益，以低价从顿巴斯购买无烟煤，而俄罗斯则以与其他出口市场相当的价格向乌克兰出售无烟煤。总体而言，我们的发现强调了可能提高制裁成本并限制其有效性的一些经济和地理特征。

articles.title_en: Corruption stereotype and the unintended consequences of an anti-corruption campaign: evidence from the real estate sector in China
articles.title_cn: 腐败刻板印象与反腐运动的意外后果：来自中国房地产行业的证据
articles.abstract_en: In an anti-corruption campaign, government officials have strong incentives to avoid taking actions that may trigger disciplinary investigations. In China’s land sales market, we find that the fraction of residential land parcels purchased by State-Owned-Enterprises (SOE) developers significantly increased after the anti-corruption campaign compared to those purchased by private developers. This result is partly driven by the following mechanism: Because selling land to private developers carries a higher corruption stereotype, local officials, particularly the relatively “clean” ones, become more reluctant to sell land to private developers for the purpose of self-preservation. Thus China’s anti-corruption campaign may have unintentionally contributed to the resurgence of the SOEs. Local officials’ corruption stereotype avoidance in an anti-corruption campaign has broad implications.
articles.abstract_cn: 在反腐运动中，政府官员有强烈的动机避免采取可能引发纪律调查的行动。在中国土地销售市场中，我们发现，与私人开发商相比，反腐运动后国有企业在住宅用地出让中的购买比例显著增加。这一结果部分由以下机制驱动：由于向私人开发商出售土地带有更高的腐败刻板印象，地方官员，尤其是相对“清廉”的官员，出于自我保护的目的，变得更加不愿向私人开发商出售土地。因此，中国的反腐运动可能无意中促进了国有企业的复兴。地方官员在反腐运动中的腐败刻板印象规避具有广泛的影响。

articles.title_en: The pond dilemma with heterogeneous relative concerns
articles.title_cn: 异质性相对关注下的池塘困境
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores team formation when workers differ in skills and their desire to out-earn co-workers. I cast this question as a two-dimensional assignment problem, characterise the equilibrium sorting and payoffs for three large classes of specifications, and find that heterogeneity in status preferences drastically changes the distributional and organisational consequences of skill-biased technological change (SBTC). Strikingly, the benefits of SBTC trickle down to low-skill workers with weak relative concerns even when there are no complementarities in production. Moreover, SBTC incentivises domestic outsourcing, as firms seek to avoid detrimental social comparisons between high- and low-skill workers, which provides a compelling explanation for the observed long-term increase in domestic outsourcing.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了当工人技能不同且渴望超越同事收入时的团队形成问题。我将此问题视为一个二维分配问题，刻画了三大类规格下的均衡排序和收益，并发现地位偏好的异质性极大地改变了技能偏向型技术进步（SBTC）的分配和组织后果。引人注目的是，即使生产中不存在互补性，SBTC的收益也会涓滴至相对关注较弱的低技能工人。此外，SBTC激励了国内外包，因为企业寻求避免高技能与低技能工人之间的有害社会比较，这为观察到的国内外包长期增长提供了一个有力的解释。

articles.title_en: Vote and trade: An efficient mechanism for common-pool resource management with stock externalities
articles.title_cn: 投票与交易：具有存量外部性的公共池塘资源管理的有效机制
articles.abstract_en: The efficiency of inter-temporal resource allocation in a rights-based common-pool resource management system can be compromised by a stock externality. This occurs when one user’s extraction depletes the resource stock and then raises future harvesting costs for all users. This paper introduces a vote-and-trade (VAT) mechanism, an enhancement to standard cap-and-trade (CAT), to correct this inefficiency. VAT operates in two stages: first, resource users vote to set a binding, period-specific extraction cap; second, they trade the resulting rights in a within-period market. Our theoretical model demonstrates that while standard CAT is dynamically inefficient, VAT can achieve the social optimum under mild conditions by using voting to aggregate agents’ private information and collectively choose the optimal inter-temporal extraction path. Laboratory experiments confirm this prediction, showing that VAT substantially outperforms CAT in aggregate economic efficiency.
articles.abstract_cn: 在基于权利的公共池塘资源管理系统中，跨期资源配置的效率可能因存量外部性而受损。当某一使用者的开采耗尽资源存量，进而提高所有使用者未来的开采成本时，便会出现这种外部性。本文引入了一种投票与交易（VAT）机制，作为对标准总量控制与交易（CAT）的改进，以纠正这一低效问题。VAT分两个阶段运作：首先，资源使用者投票设定一个具有约束力的、针对特定时期的开采上限；其次，他们在期内市场中交易由此产生的权利。我们的理论模型表明，虽然标准CAT在动态上是低效的，但VAT在温和条件下可以通过投票聚合代理人的私人信息，并集体选择最优的跨期开采路径，从而实现社会最优。实验室实验证实了这一预测，显示VAT在总体经济效率上显著优于CAT。
